title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.61
summary: Emergency stability fix: bound go2rtc/backend memory during kiosk and recording, share motion media and avoid duplicate H264 encoders.
changes: Graceful single-pass Docker upgrade and recording finalization
Bound camera connection starts and do not block recording scheduler
Reject stale/frozen HLS previews and recover their backend publishers
Authenticate local HLS playlists and MPEG-TS segments
Isolate simultaneous kiosk tile players and extend CI regression tests
Restore low-connectivity snapshot H.264 fallback for permanent, recording, motion and prebuffer paths
Restore central Live preview audio and bounded startup for slow WiFi RTSP sources
Preserve original MPEG-TS timestamps during local HLS remux
Warm ONVIF PTZ Move and Stop connections when opening PTZ controls without waiting for camera auth on pointer down
Reduce redundant ContinuousMove pulses while preserving separate prioritized Stop
Use a 3-second browser HLS target for interactive Live, maintain 8-second kiosk buffer, and seek only lagged PTZ Live players
Guard recording watchdog against atomic file-rename races and prevent duplicate finalization scans
Use lightweight in-memory recording status for kiosk polling instead of database queries per recording
Suppress transient kiosk API status errors; bounded requests preserve existing last-good camera status
Read fresh local HLS segments already produced by backend preview for motion, before starting a separate RTSP/HLS reader
Pause offline x264 compression while recording or host load is high; preserve recording copy and fallback functionality
Container memory caps and orphaned go2rtc producer cleanup protect VM during kiosk/recording overload
H264 audio transcode copies video and motion migrates to central low-bandwidth ingest
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.61
description: Reuse recent central HLS segments for motion and prevent x264 recompression from starving live recording or HLS streams.
releaseNotes: Preserves upgrade compatibility from 2.20.32. Motion prefers local completed HLS media, falls back to prior RTSP path; background compression pauses for recording and high system load.
